en: A tinted vintage postcard showing three people in traditional clothing gathered outdoors in front of a brick or mud-brick arched doorway. A standing man in white is preparing and pouring coffee from a large pot on a small brazier or stand, while a seated figure in green drinks and another seated figure in a veil and robe holds a child. Lush foliage is visible to the right. The French caption at the bottom reads 'Cafetier arabe.' The lower margin also contains small-print publisher information and a circular stamp-like emblem.
